title: Preparing the loop host
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be Boolean finite Turing machines, let $a$ be a state of $B$, choose a mode bit, functions $R,T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and an input word $x$. Assume that $F$ computes the function sending each input $y$ to the binary expansion of $R(|y|)$ in time $T(|y|)$. Then there are a configuration $c$ of $F$ on $x$ and a time $t$ such that $c$ is halted, its output is the binary expansion of $R(|x|)$, $t\leq 5T(|x|)+7$, and the loop host reaches its ready configuration built from $c$ after $t$ steps; moreover, every work-tape head of $c$ lies between $-T(|x|)$ and $T(|x|)$, inclusive.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean finite Turing machines B and F
functions R and T on natural numbers
F computes the binary expansion of R(input length) in time T(input length)
